description: English localization of the three README images containing Russian labels.

assets.prompt:
Use case: text-localization.
Asset type: GitHub README hero banner, English-language version.
Input image: the referenced PNG is the edit target. Localize ALL Russian text into English. Preserve the existing wide 3:1 aspect ratio, composition, dark blue background, realistic robot and cup on the right, point-cloud robot on the left, wireframe robot and trajectory in the center, inset frames, arrows, colors, gradients, line weights, and every non-text element. Do not redesign or add anything. This is a conceptual project illustration.
Exact replacements:
Keep "MolmoMotion × DaS" unchanged.
Replace the large two-line heading "ДИФФУЗИОННОЕ ВИДЕО" / "ДЛЯ РОБОТОТЕХНИКИ" with "DIFFUSION VIDEO" / "FOR ROBOTICS". Keep the first line white and the second line in the same cyan-to-purple gradient; fit both centered lines cleanly.
Replace "3D-геометрия" with "3D geometry".
Replace "Прогноз траекторий" with "Trajectory prediction".
Replace "Генерация видео" with "Video generation".
Replace the footer with exactly "AIRI · Alexey Petrov · @aapetrov23".
Only change the lettering. Preserve positions and the typography style. All remaining labels must be English or model names. No Cyrillic characters. Do not crop any part of the banner. Output a crisp high-resolution image preserving the original 2172×724 composition.

Use case: text-localization.
Asset type: GitHub README educational pipeline illustration, English-language version.
Input image: the referenced JPG is the edit target. Translate ALL Russian labels into English with the exact replacements below. Preserve the six-panel 1600×900 layout, panel order 1→2→3→4→5→6, arrows, numbering, original robot/cup imagery, masks, point colors, depth maps, camera, point cloud, icons, white and pale blue backgrounds, borders, fonts and navy-blue text. Change only lettering and minimally adjust font sizes for fitting. Do not modify technical content, images, dots, or diagrams.
Text replacements:
Top title: "Berkeley: data preparation and MolmoMotion inference"
Top subtitle: "Cup scene · three observed frames"
Panel 1 heading: "Input frames"
"RGB + глубина" → "RGB + depth"
"Кадры до начала прогноза" → "Frames before prediction"
Every occurrence of "Глубина" → "Depth"; "Далеко" → "Far"; "Близко" → "Near".
Panel 2: keep "MolmoPoint"; "Найти целевой предмет" → "Locate the target object".
Panel 3: keep "SAM 2.1"; "Выделить маску стакана" → "Segment the cup".
Panel 4: keep "AllTracker"; "Отследить точки в истории" → "Track points through the history"; "24 выбранные точки" → "24 selected points".
Panel 5 heading: "Prepare 3D history"; "Пиксели + глубина + K" → "Pixels + depth + K"; "Медиана глубины в окне 5 × 5" → "Median depth in a 5 × 5 window"; "Проверка геометрии" → "Geometry check".
Panel 6 heading: "Run MolmoMotion"
"3 кадра + 3D-история + текст задачи" → "3 frames + 3D history + task text"
Under the three input icons, use "3 frames", "3D history", and "Action description".
Keep "MolmoMotion-4B-H3-F30" unchanged.
"8 точек за вызов · 3 вызова" → "8 points per call · 3 calls"
"Горизонт: 30 будущих шагов" → "Horizon: 30 future steps".
Do not leave any Cyrillic text. Render every replacement sharply and readably without overlap. Preserve the 16:9 aspect ratio and all panel margins. Preserve model names and all numbers exactly. Do not invent new text.
